_what: WHO THE SYSTEM BELIEVED WAS UNPROJECTED ON THIS EXACT BOARD AND BUILD. This is a BELIEF AT A MOMENT, not an outcome. It does NOT establish whether ignoring these players was right — only a January grade against realized finishes can do that, and this snapshot exists so that grade is possible at all. Capturing the list is the cheap half of the commitment.
_perishable: After week one the projections update and nobody can reconstruct who was unprojected in August. That is why this is captured now.
_january_question: How many of these finished TOP-24 AT THEIR POSITION? A non-trivial number means the fix is ingest coverage rather than the engine. Near zero means the exclusion was legitimate.
criterion_caveat: This key CONFLATES 'projected at zero' with 'no projection'. On this board they are the same players by luck, not design — Sleeper returns a zero row for an IR player rather than omitting him. Recorded so the January grade knows what the list actually selected on.

population.note: Field population measured at write time from the bytes actually committed. `empty` fields are DECLARED BY THE PRODUCER AND NEVER DELIVERED — ask why before concluding the source has no such data.
